purpose: Owner 05.10.2026, 'teeme need tugevaks', item 1: the changes of 04.-05.10 that only local tests and model-free checks had shown, measured once with the model. Contacts in an answer (ADR-085, ADR-086: the contact directories of 76 municipalities and Tallinn, the compact view), the two server rules of ADR-084 (a situation told in an earlier message stays in the search; 'in my municipality' is the person's own one) and the Family Law Act's maintenance sections found for a question that names neither the duty nor the act (ADR-087). 'What changes' (ADR-088) is measured by scenarios-version-change-1 and the five unrelated questions by scenarios-answered-questions-1, in the same run. Written before any run with the model. Run with --auto-modes (what the chat sends). No person's name, phone or e-mail is in this file: a contact is checked by the form of a phone number or an address, and the answers with names stay on the server.

expectation_help.region: the municipal scope of the turn
expectation_help.contacts: search: the record context shows at least one contact person
expectation_help.must (contacts): answer: it gives a phone number or an e-mail address; whether it is the right person's is read from the answer and the record context on the server, a pattern cannot tell
expectation_help.must_not (contacts): answer: no sentence on when the records were collected or whether they are still current (owner 28.09.2026)
expectation_help.evidence_text: search: the words of the situation told in the earlier message are in the evidence of the turn that asks the question (ADR-084 F1)
expectation_help.person_regions / state_kept: the saved dialogue state: the residence is unchanged by a question about another municipality
expectation_help.evidence / cited / evidence_provision: the act is among the found sources, the answer has a source block that cites it, and a passage of the named section with the deciding words is in the evidence the answer was given

history: 05.10.2026, first run (commit d43f3458, corpus v58, record-catalogue-3, dialogue prompt 26): the catalogue as written before any run, 9 turns: 6 passed, 2 answer, 1 search, 0.0475 USD. Contacts: in Antsla the directory was one of the three closest records, eight people were shown and the answer gave their phones and addresses, every one of them from the context. In Tallinn and Narva no contact was shown and the answer gave none: the three closest records were services, and the right directory (Lasnamäe's, the Social Welfare Board's) stood 21st and 22nd in the relevance order and was listed by its title only; the Narva answer said it had no phone number. Both ADR-084 conversations passed: the adaptation stayed in the second turn's search, and 'minu vallas' was searched in Nõo vald. The care home question: § 96 and § 97 of the Family Law Act were candidates, the selection kept another passage of the chapter and the article on the duty, so the check on § 96 in the evidence failed; the answer states the duty and its limits and cites the act (docs/audits/evidence/strengthening-measured-2026-10-05.json). Cause of the contact failures and the change that followed: ADR-089.

05.10.2026, second run (commit 3e2ac388, ADR-089: record-catalogue-4 opens the closest contact directory, dialogue prompt 27), the three contact scenarios only, with the owner's permission: 3 turns: 3 passed, 0.0163 USD. Tallinn: the asked district's directory was opened (21st in the relevance order), eleven people shown, the answer names the district's department and one social work specialist with a phone and an address, both from that person's own text. Narva: the Social Welfare Board's directory was opened (22nd), seven people shown, the answer gives the board's secretary with two numbers, both that person's, and adds a sentence that the title does not say the secretary handles such applications. Antsla as before. No channel in any answer is outside the context (docs/audits/evidence/contact-directory-measured-2026-10-05.json).

05.10.2026, third run (commit add0624c), the conversation 'my-municipality-after-another' only, as the comparison with the first run of the same day before ADR-089: 3 turns: 3 passed, 0.0170 USD. Each answer now names one social work specialist of the asked municipality with channels that are that person's own. Summaries shown: 24, 42, 24 before and 20, 30, 20 now. Turn 1 names two kinds of help fewer than before (subsistence benefit and emergency aid are not mentioned); turns 2 and 3 say as much as before or more (turn 3 describes the service where the earlier answer only gave its page). One run each: a difference between two answers may be the change or chance (docs/audits/evidence/open-points-measured-2026-10-05.json).

scenarios.title: „Minu vallas“ pärast küsimust teise valla kohta
scenarios.source: ADR-084 F2 (Codex review of #357-#364); the first two turns are scenarios-question-region-1's, measured 04.10.2026
